data.volcano-scheduler.conf:
actions: enqueue, allocate
tiers:
- plugins:
  - name: priority
  - name: gang
    enablePreemptable: false
  - name: conformance
- plugins:
  - name: deviceshare
    arguments:
      deviceshare.VGPUEnable: true
      deviceshare.GPUSharingEnable: false
      deviceshare.GPUNumberEnable: false
      deviceshare.NodeLockEnable: true
      deviceshare.SchedulePolicy: binpack
      deviceshare.ScheduleWeight: 1
      deviceshare.GPUSelectPolicy: rf-job
      deviceshare.RFEnable: true
      deviceshare.RFPredictionEnabled: true
      deviceshare.RFEndpoint: http://127.0.0.1:18081/v1/rank
      deviceshare.RFModelVersion: rf-v4-known-states-ee35cfabe30f
      deviceshare.RFTimeoutMS: 500
      deviceshare.KnownGeometriesCMName: rf-v7-device-config
      deviceshare.KnownGeometriesCMNamespace: gpu-rf-system
  - name: predicates
